name: powerbi-toolkit
description: Edit Power BI reports and semantic models (PBIP: PBIR/TMDL) from the repo: a safe edit protocol for Desktop, a per-project layout standard, pre-commit checks for defects the official validator misses, a preflight check for the external tools it drives, bulk tools for visual naming and measure documentation, a self-updating measure catalog, and /preflight, /doctor, /describe-measures, /measure-catalog commands.
